state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
other_conditions: Applicant must be a widow and must not remarry or enter a live‑in relationship
Applicant must not be receiving financial assistance under any other widow pension scheme
If age proof is not available, the beneficiary shall be referred to the Medical Board of the concerned district for verification of age
After attaining the age of 60 years, the beneficiary shall be transferred to the Pension Scheme to Old Age Persons (Senior Citizen)
benefits_summary: Widows receive ₹1,000 per month transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
